The '''''Markess Narn''''' was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]].

Along with the ''[[Childerly]]'', they provided space defense to [[Vergesso Base]], a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] controlled by [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Ororo Transportation]] (a front of the criminal [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]]).

The strength of the [[frigate/Legends|frigate]] included a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired from the affiliate [[Natori Association]], another Syndicate branch.
